newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Azeri President reshuffles economic ministries.
newsitem.headline: Azeri President reshuffles economic ministries.

text.p: Azeri President Haydar Aliyev signed a decree on Wednesday combining two economic ministries and liquidating a large state company as part of a drive to spur economic reforms.

The Presidential Press Service said the decree combined the Ministry of External Economic Relations and the Ministry of Trade into a single new, reorganised Ministry of Trade. The state company Khalg Uchun Mallar (Goods for the People) was to be liquidated.

"The structural changes in the government were needed for speeding up the market reform programme in Azerbaijan," said Aliyev, speaking at a meeting with members of his government, shown on state television.

"We are lagging behind somewhat in carrying out reforms. This (ministry change) is not the end of the structural reform process. We will continue the liquidation of ministries and agencies and all these changes will be aimed at the successful completion of market reforms," he said.

The decree removed External Economic Relations Minister Gudrat Kuliyev from his post. Current Trade Minister Miri Gambarov is to become chairman of state company Azercontract, successor to the former Natural Resources Ministry which was dissolved six months ago.
The head of Khalg Uchun Mallar, Rafig Khalafov, was named vice-premier in Aliyev's government.
